question: Which of the following is a function performed by commercial banks in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Credit creation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Credit creation:-**

 
 
• **It is the process of lending money to create new money in the economy. **
 
• **Commercial banks do this by accepting deposits from customers and then lending out a portion of those deposits to other customers.**
 
• When a bank lends money, it creates a new loan asset on its balance sheet and a new deposit liability.
 
• This new deposit can then be used by the borrower to spend money, which in turn creates new deposits for other banks. In this way, commercial banks play a key role in the money supply.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Issue of currency:-**

 
 
• It is a function of the central bank, not commercial banks.
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is responsible for issuing currency in India.**
 
 
 
• **Banking facilities to the government:-**
 
 
• It is a function of both commercial banks and the central bank.
 
• **Commercial banks provide banking services to the government, such as collecting taxes and making payments. **
 
• The RBI also provides banking services to the government, such as managing the government's debt.
 
 
 
• **Credit control:-**
 
 
• It is a function of the central bank.
 
• **The RBI uses credit control measures to manage the money supply and inflation.**
